summary: Share incremental agent roster projections across HTTP pages and concurrent WebSocket subscribers

replay.detail: Only in-memory read caches and request admission change; no replay is introduced.

schema.detail: No tables, indexes, triggers, migrations or schema version changes.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules or digest changes; mixed builds retain the same graph semantics.

compatibility.detail: Existing HTTP pagination, collection frames, authorization, snapshot fencing and per-read delivery overlays are preserved.

downtime.detail: No additional service interruption beyond an ordinary binary upgrade restart.

manual.detail: Existing installations require no configuration or state changes.

recovery.detail: Caches are process-local and disposable; returning to the previous binary requires no database rollback.
